scripts.k8s:build: docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t scalelab-api:local . && docker build -f apps/web/Dockerfile -t scalelab-web:local .
scripts.k8s:down: kubectl delete -k infrastructure/kubernetes --ignore-not-found && kubectl delete namespace ingress-nginx --ignore-not-found
scripts.k8s:status: kubectl get pods,services,hpa,ingress -n scalelab && kubectl get pods,service -n ingress-nginx
scripts.load:rate-limit: docker compose --profile tools run --rm k6 run --summary-export=/results/rate-limit-latest.json /scripts/rate-limit.js
